input.body:
Dear Lena,

Thank you for reporting the water coming through the bathroom ceiling light fitting at Flat 1, 44 Clifton Street. Because water is coming through an electrical fitting we are treating this as an emergency (ref TKT-96050D).

What we have done:
- Booked an emergency electrician: Bright Spark Electrical (NICEIC registered), contact +44 20 7946 0105. Confirmed time slot: today, Saturday 10 October, 13:00-15:00. As you are at work, they will let themselves in using the key safe at the side door (the office will give them the code) and return the key afterwards. They will make the lighting safe and check for damage.
- We are contacting the managing agent for the flat upstairs so the leak can be stopped at the source.

What to do in the meantime (only if it is safe to do so):
- Please do not use the bathroom light. If you are still at home, or when you get back, switch off the lighting circuit (or the main switch) at the consumer unit / fuse box - the wall switch alone does not fully isolate the fitting. Do not touch the fitting or any switches with wet hands.
- Keep the bucket in place and move any belongings away from the drip.
- If the water gets much heavier, the ceiling bulges or sags, or you see sparks or smell burning, leave the room, switch off the electricity at the main switch if safe, and call 999 if there is any immediate danger, then let us know.
- If you have any pets, please let us know so we can tell the electrician.

On the ceiling staining: our check-in inventory dated 10 January 2026 records the bathroom ceiling as "good condition, no staining". If you have any photos from move-in showing staining, please email them to us and we will add them to the file. Either way, this does not affect the repair - we are dealing with it now.

We will email you again once the electrician has attended.

Kind regards,
Maintenance Team
